playful.v: A landing page for a kids coding app.
playful.r: Landing page for "PikoLab", a coding platform for kids aged 7-12: hero with mascot, features, a mini-game teaser, pricing, FAQ, CTA band.
playful.m: Homepage for a children's drawing and animation app with a gallery of kid creations, three feature highlights and a parent section.

bold.v: A landing page for a new wireless headphone.
bold.r: Launch page for "Nova X1" wireless headphones: dramatic hero, feature highlights, specs, reviews, pre-order CTA.
bold.m: Portfolio landing page for an independent motion designer: striking hero, selected work, services, client quotes, contact CTA.

technical.r: Developer observability dashboard "Tracewise": dark UI, latency chart, error rate, live log tail, code snippet to install the SDK, services list.
technical.m: CI/CD pipeline dashboard: recent builds with status, build duration chart, flaky test list, deploy history and a terminal-style log of the selected build.

trust.v: A dashboard for a small business to track money.
trust.r: Business finance dashboard "Ledgerly" for small companies: KPI cards with deltas, cash-flow chart, recent transactions table, an overdue-invoice alert, upcoming payments list.
trust.m: Patient appointments dashboard for a small clinic: today's schedule, no-show rate, waiting list, reminders sent and a day/week toggle.

editorial.r: Long-read magazine article page "The Quiet Return of the Paper Map": masthead and section nav, kicker, headline, standfirst, byline, hero illustration with caption, body with drop cap, pull quote, related stories, newsletter signup.
editorial.m: A recipe-and-essay page for a food magazine: headline, intro essay, ingredient list, numbered method, a pull quote and related recipes.
